verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm custodial accounts that can hold incoming crypto/stablecoin balances. Deposit addresses auto-credit the account balance, auto-liquidation is optional so funds can stay in stablecoin, and payouts in fiat or crypto run from the same account. A sandbox exists for testing these custodial features. However, the pack never states availability, supported geographies, eligibility, or onboarding gating, which is half of what this story asks for. Missing for 10: documented availability and supported geographies, honest statement of access gating or eligibility requirements, explicit confirmation of which stablecoins can be held as a balance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
